rachel: Quick sync  I pushed a compact migration guide PR that combines the v1->v2 banner, redirect map, and a short "what breaks" FAQ. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2178

samir: Link + thanks. Can we embed the exact SDK error strings so support can grep? Also need an embed-dim FAQ item with a tiny pad example.

miguel: I'll add the pad helper (PY + JS). Keep it tiny:

```
# py
def pad(vec, target=1536):
  return vec + [0.0]*(target-len(vec)) if len(vec)<target else vec[:target]
```

samir: perfect. For JS show the error shape too:

```
// JS SDK
try { await client.call(...) } catch (e) {
  // e.code == 410 && e.type == 'DeprecatedEndpoint'
}
```

ops-bot: Ops note: recommend path-level 301s for CDN. Canary plan: 48h @5%, then 24h @50% before full flip. Add rollback steps in playbook.

legal: We need the 21-day notice in copy and a billing note. Add FAQ line "billing unchanged during soft banner".

rachel: I'll update PR 2178 with (1) exact error snippets, (2) pad helpers, (3) rollout timeline + rollback checklist, and (4) labels `deprecation,migration,docs-ready`. Targeting merge by Wednesday AM.

samir: I'll review once you push. If anyone wants to own the post-merge announcement, volunteer here. :eyes:
